name: billing-bkash-personal

envVars.BKASH_PERSONAL_NUMBER: The personal bKash number subjects send money to, e.g. +8801712345678 or 01712345678. Required once BILLING_PROVIDER=bkash-personal: it is the destination printed in the instructions, and unset it throws BillingError("invalid_request") naming this key before a subject is sent anywhere. One receiving number per deployment — routing by amount or by tenant is not supported.
envVars.BKASH_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT_LABEL: Whose wallet the number is, e.g. "Rahim Traders". Optional, and shown beside the number in the instructions so a subject can tell they are sending to the right person. A bKash Send Money screen shows the registered name, and a mismatch is the cheapest way for a subject to catch a wrong number before they confirm.

removeWarnings: Removing this module does not refund anything, and there is nothing at bKash to cancel: a personal wallet holds no subscription and stores no instrument. Subjects simply stop being asked to pay.
Payment submissions already in billing_payment_submissions survive this removal. Review or reject the pending ones before you remove the provider, or nobody will ever decide them.
